From Maciej (ts=1785185470.118719): <@U01511MEQ90>, for the KS Tech Sync tomorrow, here's the mods we were proposing to the IP starting in September:

3. Move S3 de-ice and S3 Salt Spray to the right and S3 severe cold to the left to compensate (to better align with the Whitehorse demo)
